lp-countries.label: Countries represented among Chennai Super Kings' players
lp-countries.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
lp-countries.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, pl.name, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (9) AND d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (9) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (9) THEN d.batter_id ELSE d.bowler_id END WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND (i.batting_team_id IN (9) OR i.bowling_team_id IN (9)) GROUP BY year, pl.name
